title: Altan Khan
note: Leader of the Tümed Mongols whose 1550 raid breached Gubeikou and reached the gates of Beijing, driving the major Ming wall-building surge; later concluded the 1571 Longqing peace and fostered Tibetan Buddhism.

title: Longqing peace between the Ming and Altan Khan
note: Diplomatic settlement that ended two centuries of Ming-Mongol warfare by enfeoffing Altan Khan as Shunyi Wang and opening border markets, bringing decades of stability to northern China.

title: Tumu Crisis
note: Catastrophic defeat of the Ming expeditionary army by Esen Taishi and capture of the Zhengtong Emperor, transforming Ming strategic doctrine from forward offense to static wall defence.

title: Meeting of Altan Khan and the Third Dalai Lama at Qinghai Lake
note: Historic summit at Yanghua Temple near Qinghai Lake where Altan Khan and Sonam Gyatso established a patron-priest relationship and coined the title Dalai Lama, transforming Central Asian religious and political history.
